card.name: In-line filters in IV infusion sets
card.fires_on: The word "inline" or the "-line" piece of "in-line" when it describes a filter in an IV administration set. It appears in infusion instructions, often after a micron size.

modes.description: The word "inline" written as one word right after a filter pore size such as 0.2 micron.
